explained.summary:
The nature of the universe once set out to make the world. Now, either everything that happens follows on from that first decision, or even the most important things happen without any guiding purpose.

This echoes Marcus’s recurring question of whether the universe is ordered by a purpose or is just chance. He says that remembering it will make you calmer about many things. Either way, events are not aimed at you, and your task stays the same.
